label: Venue
description: Home, away or a neutral site (international games, Super Bowls). At a neutral site both teams are neutral.

label: Roof
description: The stadium's roof and, for a retractable roof, whether it was open.

label: Surface
description: Natural grass (hybrids included) or artificial turf.

label: Temperature
description: Average temperature over the game window, in °F. Open-air games only.

label: Precipitation
description: Rain or snow over the game window: light rain from 0.01 in, heavy from 0.10 in, any snow. Open-air games only.

label: Wind
description: Strongest wind over the game window, in mph. Open-air games only.

label: Time slot
description: Kickoff day and time in Eastern time.

label: Primetime
description: Kickoff at 7 pm ET or later.

label: Rest
description: Days since the team's previous game: 5 or fewer, 6-8, 9-12, or 13 or more (off a bye).

label: Time-zone travel
description: Time zones between the team's home stadium and the game, at kickoff.

label: Body clock
description: Kickoff time on the team's home clock: before noon, noon to 3:59 pm, 4 to 6:59 pm, or 7 pm and later.

label: Opponent type
description: A divisional opponent, another team in the same conference, or a team from the other conference.

label: Spread role
description: The team's pre-game point spread: favoured by 7 or more, by 3 to 6.5, within 3 either way, or the underdog by 3 to 6.5, or by 7 or more.
